module.purpose: Defines a utility to validate whether a given DOM node is permissible as a React DOM mount container, gating on node type and an optional feature flag.
module.summary: This module exports a single pure function that determines if a supplied node can act as a React rendering container. It accepts element, document, and document fragment nodes unconditionally, and conditionally allows comment nodes bearing a specific unstable mount-point marker when the disableCommentsAsDOMContainers flag is off. The check is defensive against null inputs and reads a shared feature flag for comment-node support.
module.businessContext: Core React DOM infrastructure. Ensures mounts target valid DOM nodes; failure could let React attach to invalid nodes and break rendering.
functions: isValidContainer (~L19-29): Validates whether a given DOM node is a permissible React mount container

moduleContractTests.when: isValidContainer(node) is called with a node having nodeType === ELEMENT_NODE
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the contract that DOM element nodes are always valid mount targets

moduleContractTests.scenario: A document node is passed as a container
moduleContractTests.when: isValidContainer(node) is called with a node having nodeType === DOCUMENT_NODE
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the contract that document nodes are valid mount targets

moduleContractTests.scenario: A document fragment node is passed as a container
moduleContractTests.when: isValidContainer(node) is called with a node having nodeType === DOCUMENT_FRAGMENT_NODE
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the contract that document fragment nodes are valid mount targets

moduleContractTests.scenario: Null or undefined is passed as a container
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the contract that nullish values are rejected as containers

moduleContractTests.scenario: A node with a non-container node type (e.g. text node) is passed
moduleContractTests.when: isValidContainer(node) is called with a text node (nodeType === 3)
moduleContractTests.then: The result is falsy unless it is the special react-mount-point-unstable comment
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the contract that arbitrary node types are rejected

moduleContractTests.scenario: A comment node with the special react-mount-point-unstable value is passed
moduleContractTests.when: isValidContainer(node) is called with a comment node whose nodeValue is ' react-mount-point-unstable '
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the contract that the unstable comment mount point is accepted when the flag is disabled

moduleContractTests.scenario: A comment node with the special react-mount-point-unstable value is passed while the feature flag is enabled
moduleContractTests.when: isValidContainer(node) is called with a comment node whose nodeValue is ' react-mount-point-unstable '
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the contract that comment mount points are rejected when the flag is enabled

moduleContractTests.scenario: A comment node with arbitrary nodeValue (not the mount point) is passed
moduleContractTests.when: isValidContainer(node) is called with a comment node whose nodeValue is not ' react-mount-point-unstable '
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the contract that generic comment nodes are not valid containers

detail.name: isValidContainer
preconditions: node may be of any type, including null or undefined.
postconditions: Returns true only if node is a non-null Node whose nodeType is ELEMENT_NODE, DOCUMENT_NODE, DOCUMENT_FRAGMENT_NODE, or (when disableCommentsAsDOMContainers is false) a COMMENT_NODE whose nodeValue is exactly ' react-mount-point-unstable '.
Returns false for all other cases, including null, undefined, or text/comment nodes that do not meet the criteria.
invariants: React does not mutate the node argument during this check.
edgeCases: If node is null or undefined, returns false.
If node does not have a nodeType property, returns false.
If node is a comment node and disableCommentsAsDOMContainers is enabled, returns false even if nodeValue matches the expected string.
If node.nodeType matches any of the accepted types except COMMENT_NODE, returns true regardless of disableCommentsAsDOMContainers.
detail.summary: Determines whether a given node is a valid React mount container by checking if it is an element, document, document fragment, or a special unstable comment node with the value ' react-mount-point-unstable '.
